name: Yebona
audience: Businesses preparing China–Africa sourcing or import-service requests.

features.title: China sourcing service providers | Yebona
features.description: Explore Yebona’s sourcing-provider workflow and request access for your China–Africa trade needs.
features.headline: Start the sourcing conversation with the requirement.
features.intro:
A sourcing request becomes easier to discuss when the product, quantity and requirements are clear. Yebona is being presented around finding providers for the work behind China–Africa trade.

The provider workflow includes service categories and provider records. Use those records to understand who offers the relevant service, then confirm the scope directly before making a commercial commitment. The public site currently invites early-access requests.
paragraphs: A sourcing request becomes easier to discuss when the product, quantity and requirements are clear. Yebona is being presented around finding providers for the work behind China–Africa trade.

The provider workflow includes service categories and provider records. Use those records to understand who offers the relevant service, then confirm the scope directly before making a commercial commitment. The public site currently invites early-access requests.
features.audience: Businesses preparing China–Africa sourcing or import-service requests.

benefits.title: Describe the requirement
benefits.body: Specify the product or service you need and what matters to the order. A clear requirement gives a prospective provider something concrete to respond to.

benefits.title: Review the provider record
benefits.body: Inspect the service category and the information available about the provider. A listing is a starting point for due diligence.

benefits.title: Confirm the scope
benefits.body: Discuss what is included, what evidence will be supplied and what remains your responsibility before agreeing to proceed.

steps: Confirm the proposed service and terms.
features.limitations: Provider availability and commercial terms must be confirmed. Do not infer that every category, supplier or transaction service is currently open for immediate use.
features.example: An importer seeking a sourcing agent can describe the intended goods and the checks needed, then use that brief when discussing a possible engagement.
features.availability: Early-access marketing; request access and confirm provider/service availability before a transaction.

features.title: Import-service provider profiles | Yebona
features.description: Review provider categories, services and available portfolio information in Yebona’s trade-services workflow.
features.headline: Compare the service before choosing the provider.
features.intro:
Two providers in the same category may offer different work. Comparing the scope is more useful than choosing from a name alone.

Yebona’s provider model includes services, portfolio information and review records. Use the information that is actually present, ask about missing details and confirm whether the provider can deliver the required work for your situation.
paragraphs: Two providers in the same category may offer different work. Comparing the scope is more useful than choosing from a name alone.

Yebona’s provider model includes services, portfolio information and review records. Use the information that is actually present, ask about missing details and confirm whether the provider can deliver the required work for your situation.
features.audience: Businesses preparing China–Africa sourcing or import-service requests.

benefits.title: Look at the offered service
benefits.body: Check the provider’s listed category and service details. Make sure they match the particular import task rather than a broadly similar label.

benefits.title: Inspect supporting information
benefits.body: Review available portfolio and feedback records, while distinguishing supplied evidence from claims that still need checking.

benefits.title: Ask specific questions
benefits.body: Clarify the deliverables, timing, charges and exceptions before selecting a provider. Keep the final agreed scope in your own commercial records.

features.limitations: Reviews and portfolio records may be incomplete or unavailable. A profile does not guarantee quality, availability or successful delivery.
features.example: For a factory-inspection request, ask what the inspection includes and what report will be supplied. Compare those answers before deciding who to engage.
features.availability: Early-access marketing; request access and confirm provider/service availability before a transaction.

features.title: Freight and import-service planning | Yebona
features.description: Prepare a freight-service requirement and explore Yebona’s China–Africa trade-provider workflow.
features.headline: Define the shipment before asking for the service.
features.intro:
Freight arrangements depend on the shipment, route and work required at each end. A clear brief makes it easier to compare a provider’s proposal and identify what is missing.

Yebona’s public service categories include freight and shipping alongside sourcing and other trade support. Use the early-access conversation to explain the actual requirement and confirm which providers or services are available.
paragraphs: Freight arrangements depend on the shipment, route and work required at each end. A clear brief makes it easier to compare a provider’s proposal and identify what is missing.

Yebona’s public service categories include freight and shipping alongside sourcing and other trade support. Use the early-access conversation to explain the actual requirement and confirm which providers or services are available.
features.audience: Businesses preparing China–Africa sourcing or import-service requests.

benefits.title: Describe the shipment
benefits.body: Prepare the goods description, origin, destination and handling requirements you know. Mark unknown details for confirmation instead of guessing them.

benefits.title: Clarify the service boundary
benefits.body: Ask what the provider handles and what remains outside the quotation. Keep transport, customs and local delivery responsibilities explicit.

benefits.title: Review before committing
benefits.body: Compare the actual proposal and supporting terms. A visible category does not itself establish a booked shipment or confirmed price.

steps: Review the proposed responsibilities and terms.
features.limitations: Shipping routes, quotations, customs requirements and service availability must be confirmed for the shipment. No delivery-time or customs-clearance guarantee is implied.
features.example: A business preparing a shipment can use a written brief to ask which part of the route a provider covers and which charges remain separate.
features.availability: Early-access marketing; request access and confirm provider/service availability before a transaction.
